pieces.Text: You are adept at ripping away an opponent's mental mask, exposing its true visage during a psychic duel.

While in a psychic duel, when you create an offensive manifestation that can be negated or halved only with a successful Will saving throw, if your opponent fails that Will saving throw, its mental mask is shattered, revealing the opponent's true form. Special: If you possess the Third Eye feat, your opponent's mental mask is shattered even on a successful Will saving throw.
